difficulty_reason: Flatness and K-flatness of a special good differential graded algebra: rewrites f^*A_i as the free algebra generated by the pulled-back graded sets f^{-1}S_0 .. f^{-1}S_i with the inductive differential, so the claim reduces to graded flatness plus K-flatness; the latter is proved by filtering A_i over a well-ordered set W, checking the successor steps through the direct-sum and admissible-short-exact-sequence stability lemmas and closing with A_i = colim_w F_w A_i. Retained author proof at lines 5645-5757.
